heroHeadline: European Tour Opens Tonight in Barcelona — 'DtMF' Holds 59-Week All-Time Hot Latin Songs Record as Zara BENITO ANTONIO Collection Sells Out Globally
heroSubtitle: Bad Bunny tonight opened the European stadium leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona — his first European stadium concerts in six years, with both Barcelona nights (May 22–23) sold out at 54,000 capacity. Spanish press dubbed it 'Spain's biggest tour of the year.' The European leg continues in Lisbon, then two Madrid nights, before the world tour closes across additional stadium markets in summer 2026. The Barcelona opening arrives one day after the global launch of the Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' 150-piece collection (named after his real name Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio, created with creative director Janthony Oliveras), which launched at midnight ET on May 21 across 41 markets — first teased at the Super Bowl LX halftime show and debuted at the 2026 Met Gala. 'DtMF' holds 59 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs — the longest chart run in the chart's 60+ year history. The Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916, Vivid Red, $120) wide release via Adidas Confirmed is eight days away (May 30). The Porto Rico epic film (directed by Residente, co-starring Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem) remains in pre-production with principal photography expected late 2026.
